metadata.project: AI Verdict — Enterprise Agentic SOC Intelligence Platform
metadata.architecture_version: AIS 2.1 + Audit Remediation v2.2.1 + Phase 8.1 Hardening
metadata.weighting_rule: Unweighted criteria ratio per feature (satisfied_impl / applicable_impl; verified_acc / applicable_acc); NOT_APPLICABLE criteria excluded from denominator with explicit justification. Module and overall percentages sum raw criteria across features.

features.feature_name: 9-Section Policy Studio Workspace & Rule Prompt Management
evidence_notes: 9-section schema, CRUD API, rule UUID/rule_id resolution, and live headless Chromium AIS Studio UI click-through verified across test_phase8_ui_e2e.py & test_phase8_1_ui_e2e.py.

acceptance_criteria.description: 9-section versioned prompt storage & CRUD API
Rule UUID and SIEM rule_id resolution in get_or_create_rule_prompt
Live browser UI form E2E click-through

features.feature_name: Rule Intelligence Analyzer & Archetype Classification (12 Archetypes)
evidence_notes: Observed sentBytes64 cleanly isolated from authoritative SIEM thresholds; 12 archetypes verified in test_req01/req02.
features.remaining_gap: None within deterministic rule analyzer scope.

acceptance_criteria.description: Distinguish observed incident metrics from authoritative thresholds
Classify SIEM rules into versioned archetypes

features.feature_name: Detection-Aware 9-Section Draft Synthesis & Compiler Parity
evidence_notes: All 9 sections compiled deterministically with SHA-256 compilation digest shared across live triage and simulation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Unified 9-section policy compiler with digest
Drafts remain in DRAFT status pending Admin approval

features.feature_name: Approval, Rollback Safety Gates & Drift Lifecycle Monitor
evidence_notes: Remediated pull_rule_and_register draft auto-activation, rollback gate enforcement, approval regression check, and PolicyLifecycleMonitor hooks on FortiSIEM XML/rule refresh + verified learning feedback.
features.remaining_gap: Rule-level summary metrics table updated; bulk background job does not auto-retrain drafts (by governance design).

acceptance_criteria.description: Approval enforces Quality Gates + latest G8 simulation regression check
Rollback validates target quality gates before activation
SIEM rule refresh and verified feedback emit PolicyDriftEvent records
Auto-generated drafts never auto-assign active_version_id

features.feature_name: 8-Gate Policy Quality Validator (G1–G8)
evidence_notes: G1-G8 gate scoring, G5 RFC-1918 checks, G7 consistency, G8 INCONCLUSIVE/stale-digest checks, and P8.1-DEF-004 3-tier eligibility separation (structural vs empirical vs autonomous) verified.
features.remaining_gap: G8 remains WARNING (0/15 pts) until >=5 verified rule-matched ground truth cases are accumulated per rule.

acceptance_criteria.description: G1-G6 hard gate enforcement including undistorted G5 RFC-1918/loopback detection
G7 blocking detection on missing Section 4 / TP-FP contradiction
G8 regression blocker and policy_digest staleness validation

features.feature_name: Historical Simulation & Paired Regression Engine
evidence_notes: Honors candidate policy_version_id, records policy_digest, queries real historical counts (no fabricated 85%), and supports OPENAI_COMPATIBLE vs SIMULATED modes; OPENAI_COMPATIBLE simulation branch unverified against live Server 2.
features.remaining_gap: OPENAI_COMPATIBLE simulation branch against live vLLM Server 2 unexecuted in offline test environment.

acceptance_criteria.description: 6-stage eligibility funnel & strict rule-matching without fabricated 85% accuracy
Policy-version-aware simulation output & digest recording
End-to-end simulation replay against live Server 2 OPENAI_COMPATIBLE provider

features.feature_name: Bulk Policy Quality Audit
evidence_notes: Chunked read-only audit job & summary aggregation verified in test_req09_bulk_policy_quality_audit.

acceptance_criteria.description: Non-mutating batch quality scoring across rule library

features.feature_name: Live Incident Triage Pipeline & Offline Fail-Closed Behavior
evidence_notes: Enforces policy approval (including unmapped rules in non-simulated triage), runs unified AIS 2.1 trust scoring, blocks mock fallback in production, and writes authoritative outcome across Investigation/Timeline/Token/Audit tables.
features.remaining_gap: Real-time GPU inference latency & accuracy depend on live Server 2 availability.

acceptance_criteria.description: Enforce approved policy guard (even when rule is None) and offline 503 failure
Persist authoritative final verdict to incident, investigation, timeline, token & audit logs
Zero-leakage ground-truth payload sanitization & verified semantic RAG injection

features.feature_name: Per-Incident Concurrency Safety, Idempotency & Bounded Reevaluation
evidence_notes: DB DistributedLockManager atomic lease UPSERT, pre-commit lease verify_or_renew abort on expiry/takeover (P8.1-DEF-001), idempotent note upsert, and bounded 3-attempt reevaluation verified.
features.remaining_gap: None (cross-process OS locking and idempotency verified in test_phase8_integration.py).

acceptance_criteria.description: Idempotent note updates and cross-process DB/Redis distributed locking across OS workers
Bounded automatic reevaluation after policy approval (max 3 attempts)

features.feature_name: Evidence-Preserving Token Budgeting & Context Overflow Guard
evidence_notes: Verified token prioritization and safe REQUIRES_ATTENTION abstention on context overflow.

acceptance_criteria.description: Deterministic token allocation & safe context overflow abstention

features.feature_name: Canonical Evidence Normalization & Cryptographic Integrity Digests
evidence_notes: Supports FortiSIEM aliases (sentBytes64, direction, processBlocked), unique digest-salted IDs on duplicate payload fields, and exposes canonical_evidence via /api/incidents/{id}/model-payload.

acceptance_criteria.description: Normalize raw SIEM attributes with SHA-256 digests and collision-safe evidence IDs
Model payload endpoint returns canonical_evidence with aligned UI schema fields

features.feature_name: Rule-Bound Evidence Contracts & Preflight Completeness Validator
evidence_notes: Contracts strictly bound to PromptVersion APPROVED state; preflight rejects missing critical telemetry before inference.

acceptance_criteria.description: Approved contract resolution & critical preflight abstention gate

features.feature_name: Deterministic Verdict Validator, Claim Grounding & Replay Engine
evidence_notes: Blocked empty-claim/blanket-FP bypasses, separated proposal_validation_outcome vs final_disposition vs abstention_reason, and marked malformed model output INVALID_MODEL_OUTPUT (P8.1-DEF-002).

acceptance_criteria.description: Prevent empty-claim and blanket-FP decisive bypasses
Detect fabricated hashes/IPs/processes & tampered replay state

features.feature_name: AIS 2.1 Evidence Sufficiency, Claim Validator & Safety Guardrails
evidence_notes: Remediated detection.* non-telemetry blocker mismatch, generalized unsupported numeric threshold check, string boolean Process Blocked check, low-signal word false matching, and empty decisive claim guardrail.

acceptance_criteria.description: Mandatory telemetry & contradiction checks override LLM verdict
Schema-aligned claim verification & threshold assertion guard

features.feature_name: 5-Dimension Trust Scoring (1–10 Ordinal Scale & Uncalibrated Cap)
evidence_notes: Real DB-backed trust assessments, NOT_CALCULABLE handling, contradiction/ungrounded trust cap <=3, and invalid model output trust cap <=2 (P8.1-DEF-003) verified.
features.remaining_gap: Real production DB currently holds 0 calibrated rules until >=30 adjudicated historical outcomes per rule accumulate.

acceptance_criteria.description: Compute 5-dimension trust score, cap <=6 when uncalibrated (<30 cases), support NOT_CALCULABLE
Eliminate hardcoded mock sample_count=10/accuracy=85% and persist records from live triage

features.feature_name: Expected Calibration Error (ECE), Brier Score & Uncertainty Reporting
evidence_notes: Requires N>=30 and >=3 samples in both classes before emitting CALIBRATED; reports Brier score, ECE, and 5 reliability bins cleanly.
features.remaining_gap: Awaiting empirical production dataset >=30 per rule for post-hoc Platt/isotonic calibration curve fitting.

acceptance_criteria.description: Class-balance & sample-size calibration gating (N>=30, min 3 per class)

features.feature_name: Leakage-Safe Historical Ground Truth Isolation & Adjudication
evidence_notes: Strips cleared/resolution keys recursively before inference; rejects ML-generated ground truth labels; partitions deterministically via SHA-256.
features.remaining_gap: Real SOC historical closure dataset volume remains external dependency.

acceptance_criteria.description: Sanitize ground truth from all model-facing payloads & rule-boundary RAG
Reject synthetic/ML ground-truth labels and deterministic train/tuning/calibration/locked-test split

features.feature_name: Empirical Accuracy Metrics, Wilson 95% CIs & Risk-Coverage Curves
evidence_notes: Returns None (not 0.0) when denominators are zero; computes Wilson score intervals and 10-step risk-coverage curve.

acceptance_criteria.description: Wilson 95% CIs, undefined-denominator None preservation, and risk-coverage curve

FortiSIEM incremental pull & idempotent incident deduplication (fixture/mocked)
Live FortiSIEM appliance pull against customer Supervisor endpoint
